title: 机器学习编译优化工程师 - Seed Model
jd_text:
团队介绍：字节跳动 Seed 团队成立于 2023 年，致力于寻找通用智能的新方法，追求智能上限，为科技和社会发展作出贡献。

Seed 团队在 AI 领域拥有长期愿景与决心，团队研究方向涵盖 MLLM、GenMedia、AI for Science、机器人等，在中国、新加坡、美国等地设有实验室和岗位。目前，团队已推出业界领先的通用大模型以及前沿的多模态能力，支持豆包、即梦、TRAE 等超过 50 个应用场景，并通过火山引擎开放给企业客户。第三方数据显示，豆包 App 用户量在中国市场排名第一，豆包大模型日均 Token 调用量行业领先。

1、参与AI编译器相关项目的技术方案规划，设计在离线全系统的计算图优化链路；

3、与全公司算法部门深度合作，为重点项目进行算法与系统的联合优化。

title: 测试开发工程师（Feeds）-TikTok内容发现（上海）
jd_text:
团队介绍：TikTok是一个覆盖150个国家和地区的国际短视频平台，我们希望通过TikTok发现真实、有趣的瞬间，让生活更美好。TikTok 在全球各地设有办公室，全球总部位于洛杉矶和新加坡，办公地点还包括纽约、伦敦、都柏林、巴黎、柏林、迪拜、雅加达、首尔和东京等多个城市。

TikTok内容发现团队负责的产品功能涵盖TikTok所有内容分发的场景，包括首页的搜索、推荐信息流等核心场景，通过个性化手段以及产品功能来满足用户发现内容的诉求。在这里，有大牛带队与大家一同不断探索前沿，突破想象空间。在这里，你的每一行代码都将服务亿万用户。在这里，团队专业且纯粹，合作氛围平等且轻松。

1、负责TikTok主架构业务的质量保障，测试技术、工具和平台创新；
2、能够快速拉通大中型项目测试体系建立、测试流程、测试实施、质量和风险控制；
3、推进和改进各端的测试能力提升，落地自动化测试机制，持续推进测试效率提升；
4、线上稳定性保障，重要线上问题的分析，定位，同时推进相关问题系统性优化解决；
5、营造良好的质量氛围，提升研发团队的质量意识，不断推动质量的建设。

有资产监管 / 性能预算 / 资源体检类系统的建设经验。

有数据可视化经验（ECharts / Grafana / Superset）。 关于这个岗位：
你将参与一套游戏资产数据系统的开发与落地，负责把引擎各环节的资产数据采集起来、整理成一致的指标、通过可视化界面呈现给使用者，支撑他们快速定位问题、优化决策。
你将深入引擎的资产管线与性能分析工具，理解游戏资产从生产到运行时的全链路状态，并把散落在各处的数据串成可用的链路。同时，你需要独立完成数据后端与前端界面的实现。
这是一位能贯通数据采集、数据治理、分析判定与界面呈现的全链路工程师。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

职位描述：
资产数据体系：规划并搭建游戏资产数据的全生命周期监管能力，覆盖从生产到运行时使用的全链路，支撑多类型资产、多平台、多项目的长期演进。
数据采集与治理：设计并落地资产数据的采集、校准、存储、查询体系，保证数据的可信、可扩展、可持续。
分析能力与判定体系：建设资产数据的分析、判定与统计能力，形成可复用的方法论与组件，支撑业务方对异常对象的识别与决策。
数据呈现与产品化：将数据能力产品化，通过可视化界面呈现给使用者，让数据真正被看见、理解、使用。
系统集成与流程闭环：充分复用部门已有工具与系统，把资产数据能力接入研发流程（构建、验证、发布），形成从发现到闭环的自动化链路。
协作、落地与持续演进：与上下游团队协作推动规范与流程落地；随业务演进持续扩展能力边界，并反哺工具链与部门技术资产。

title: Edge POP资源交付经理 - DCS
jd_text:

title: 成本经理（数据中心/商办）
jd_text:
1、负责各数据中心/商业办公项目的估算和组织项目概算，审核并参与编制投资估算及设计概算，开展各项目全过程成本管控的复核，拟定项目或分部分项的目标成本，并复核动态管控；
2、负责招投标过程中成本管控各项指标的复核，审核并参与合约分判、商务评标报告编制、复核项目合约相关条款及报价合理性，统筹各项目结算管理，复核或编制结算报告，对有争议的结算项负责参与结算谈判；
3、调查分析和评估目标市场，参与大宗采购项目的谈判、签约，复查合同的执行和落实情况；
4、负责定期组织设计、工程、运维等项目参与方进行成本管理复盘及技术优化建议；
5、负责建立健全成本管控体系，配合各职责体系建立概算、估算、预算、招投标、结算等制度流程；
6、负责组织收集行业相关成本数据指标，建立和完善公司项目数据指标库。

title: 国际支付高级工程师-全球网络
jd_text:
1、参与国际支付全球网络能力建设，实现全球各区域的支付、收单系统对接，覆盖从用户/商户的签约、绑卡、支付、清结算以及数字银行卡户服务等流程；
2、负责相关支付网络核心系统、组件、框架的设计开发，高效支撑各类业务需求的同时，持续提升研发质量、效率、系统性能和稳定性，构建行业领先的全球化支付网络系统架构；
3、协同产品、商务、运营做好业务规划、技术方案制定及评审；
4、参与AI/LLM技术在支付场景中的落地建设，包括：
1）基于大模型全面重塑与合作伙伴的连接集成模式、支付信息治理能力、智能支付网络决策能力以及支付网络运营能力，提升合作伙伴接入效率与网络治理水平，达成覆盖、成本、时效和成功率等各项能力的行业领先；
2）基于大模型沉淀全球各地区的支付行业知识，实现研发、运营和策略分析的全面提效；
3）探索AI Coding在资金安全要求严格的金融领域的实践。

title: UE引擎开发工程师-抖音研发
jd_text:
1、负责基于Unreal Engine 5引擎进行数字人、虚拟仿真等项目的开发工作，包括场景搭建、关卡设计、蓝图逻辑编写及C++代码开发；​
2、针对项目需求，优化Unreal Engine 5项目的运行性能，涵盖渲染效率、帧率稳定性、内存占用等关键指标，解决开发过程中的技术瓶颈；
3、负责Unreal Engine 5项目中各类资产（模型、材质、动画、特效等）的导入、整合与优化，制定规范的资产管理流程，确保资产在项目中的高效复用；
4、独立完成Unreal Engine 5项目中特定功能模块的开发，如角色控制系统、物理碰撞系统、AI行为逻辑、交互系统等，并编写相应的技术文档。

title: 混元训练 Infra 工程师-Dataloader/Checkpoint 方向-（北京/深圳/上海/杭州）
jd_text:
1.分布式 Dataloader：多源数据加载框架研发，优化预处理流水线、IO 瓶颈与数据倾斜，对接对象存储 / 分布式文件系统，支持动态采样与增量更新；​；
2.Checkpoint 管理：设计高吞吐存储 / 加载方案，优化压缩、分片与冷热分层，实现版本管理、备份恢复与分布式训练框架兼容；​；
3.系统优化：监控吞吐 / 延迟 / 显存指标，定位性能瓶颈，保障极端场景下训练连续性；​；
4.跨团队协作：对齐业务需求，沉淀技术最佳实践。​。

title: 《王者荣耀世界》资深关卡策划
jd_text:
1.根据项目设定背景，进行游戏关卡设计和制作，包括但不限于PVP/PVE地图、AI、怪物、各类事件处理等；
2.独立进行初期关卡设计，使用3D引擎搭建白模关卡并验证可行性，确保内容符合生成要求和技术规范；
3.关卡制作完成后，根据线上数据和反馈来迭代优化并在后续设计中总结归纳设计经验；
4.对特定产品的关卡进行拆解分析，依据一定方法论进行可持续的关卡设计产出；
5.能够与LA深度合作进行关卡设计与制作，确保关卡内容在游戏性和视觉两个层面都能达到较高的水准；
6.能和文学、任务策划深入合作，完成任务关卡的搭建和叙事体验的落地。

title: 《逆战端游》-关卡策划-（深圳/武汉）
jd_text:
1.对端游现有游戏模式的关卡设计和制作（主要为PVE地图，AI，BOSS，各类事件等）：使用2D绘图软件设计关卡；使用3D引擎搭建关卡；
2.撰写模式玩法或者玩法元素模块的设计方案，制作模式地图，跟进程序功能、相关工具、美术资源等的实现与优化；
3.负责产品新模式的扩展设计和开发：分析市场，确定模式定位；
4.模式、关卡上线后的跟进：关注相关统计数据，调研问卷，论坛，游戏网站等体现具体使用情况和玩家反馈的来源；有必要时，根据数据和反馈来制定后续优化方案并跟进具体开发。

title: 粒粒的小人国-游戏运营-数据分析
jd_text:
1.负责粒粒的小人国及其他筹备新品的手游数据分析工作，包括数据体系搭建、持续的版本表现分析、以及用户和市场数据研究等；
2.负责数据体系搭建，如数据打点、上报和经分系统的搭建等，建立关键指标的日常监控机制，搭建各类专项数据分析框架；
3.负责市场和用户数据分析，根据游戏定位，进行目标用户分层，预估市场规模和用户空间，并能根据目标用户属性反推游戏设计；
4.进行竞品监测，保持对核心竞品和新游的关注，监控关键数据表现，为游戏提供方向性指导和参考。

title: 商品研发工程师
jd_text:
1. 梳理结构设计资源缺口与能力短板，明确招聘方向并制定团队搭建方案；
2. 主导AI硬件产品整机结构方案设计，确保成本、工艺与可靠性满足产品目标；
3. 建立与电子、散热、外观等专业的协同机制，解决开发过程中的结构技术问题；
4. 总结结构设计共性问题与经验，制定设计规范与评审要点，提升团队设计质量与效率。 1. 具备AI硬件产品从概念到量产的整机结构方案设计与论证经验，确保成本、工艺与可靠性满足目标；
2. 有结构设计团队搭建与资源规划经验，能根据业务需求明确岗位方向并组建团队；
3. 能够与电子、散热、外观等专业协同，解决结构相关技术问题，保障项目按计划推进；
4. 具备在多专业耦合场景中定位结构失效根本原因的能力，优先解决影响交付的关键环节；
5. 主动学习AI硬件新形态、新材料与新工艺，并应用于结构设计以提升产品竞争力；
6. 符合京东价值观：客户为先、创新、拼搏、担当、感恩、诚信。

title: 客户端开发工程师（C++）
jd_text:
(1)本科及以上学历，计算机、电子、通信等相关专业
(2)5年以上的Windows等平台开发经验，熟练掌握C++，有主机端（PS5、XBOX、Switch）开发经验优先
(3)熟悉Windows等平台的系统知识，比如进程间通信, Win32消息机制等
(4)良好的计算机基础知识，熟悉计算机网络基础原理、数据结构等
(5)了解过任意一款游戏客户端引擎，有UE引擎研发经验、主机游戏研发经验更佳。
(6)具备 AI 相关落地实践能力优先
(7)有较好的产品意识，积极乐观，责任心强，抗压能力强，工作认真细致，具有良好的团队沟通与协作能力 (1)负责Windows&主机端（PS5、XBOX、Switch）平台SDK的开发以及封装工作，编写高质量的接入文档。例如游戏帐号登录支付、webview、日志统计等
(2)负责Windows等客户端基础组件及基础架构的开发和优化
(3)负责Windows&主机端（PS5、XBOX、Switch）平台SDK与游戏引擎的集成
(4)积极主动协助游戏接入SDK以及解决接入问题
(5)探索落地 AI 辅助能力，搭建 SDK 配套智能工具，提升 SDK 研发与游戏接入效率

title: 高级/资深技术策划工程师（归唐）
jd_text:
1、有丰富的游戏项目经验，熟悉游戏策划的工作方式和游戏开发的各个环节；
2、有较强的逻辑思维能力，具备软件工程学基本知识和一定的代码能力，熟悉C#语言，具有丰富的商业引擎的使用经验（Unity/Unreal）；
3、具备优秀的学习能力和独立解决问题的能力；良好的沟通能力、团队协作能力。

加分项
1、具备完整的大型项目开发经验和上市产品；
2、有丰富的关卡策划，系统策划和数值策划相关的开发经验。 1、针对提升游戏表现力的前沿技术进行攻坚，包括但不仅限于：剧情、关卡、AI、角色、运动、镜头、打击感等；
2、以开发高品质游戏为目的，打造高效率、高质量的游戏生产线，设计开发相应的生产工具以及开发流程；
3、指导策划、程序、美术、动画、音频等部门具体实施游戏所需功能和整合数据，从全局的角度把控游戏开发的整体流程；
4、为游戏策划以及其他相关部门提供技术支持，包括编写技术文档，提供指导和培训。

title: 专家/资深关卡美术（归唐）
jd_text:
1. 美术专业背景，熟悉或了解3A游戏的开发流程，以LA的身份参加过2个以上项目的完整开发；
2. 熟悉各类模型及贴图软件（3Dmax/SP/SD/ZB/PS）并且能够独立完成场景建筑模型及道具，能够自主拆分和组合模块化建筑模型（有场景、道具设计能力者尤佳）；
3.精通地形创建工作流程（world machine or Gaia）；丰富的建筑、城市规划和视觉设计知识，通过色彩搭配、阴影、轮廓剪影、构图和美术资产布局来营造氛围，构建出最佳视觉效果的游戏场景；
4. 擅长调整和改善关卡的制作方式以平衡美术效果和游戏性能；
4.对行业标准 3D 建模包以及纹理和材质创建工作流程有深入的了解；
5. 熟悉UE5引擎操作；
6.良好的学习能力、沟通协作能力；
7.热爱游戏，对3A 游戏有深入了解或者资深玩家。 1. 配合TA和程序制定游戏的优化方案，确保所有图形内容满足最佳性能所需的技术要求；
2. 根据关卡策划的规划及场景原画的设定负责3D美术资源的制作及整合工作，以架构出整个游戏环境；
3.制作原型并最终确定视觉上令人惊叹的关卡，优先考虑可信度、美观、可玩性、情绪和环境故事讲述；
4.创建高质量的材质和 3D 资产以增强游戏的视觉吸引力；
5.与主美或艺术总监紧密合作，确保关卡遵循游戏美术风格与技术规范。

title: 资深绑定师（归唐）
jd_text:
• 5年以上角色绑定经验，写实表情绑定专项3年以上；
• 面部解剖学功底深：能独立判断并解决眉弓/皱眉肌、眼轮匝肌/双眼皮褶皱、口轮匝肌/唇珠/嘴角、颧骨/苹果肌联动、牙齿贴合等肌肉形态问题；熟悉FACS/AU体系；
• 精通Maya Blendshape与骨骼混合绑定，熟悉MetaHuman管线与240 Shape级别表情资产制作；
• 有面部扫描数据处理经验（扫描表情→Wrapping→融合修复）；
• 熟悉UE5面部资产规范与引擎内验证流程；
• 具备Python/Mel工具开发能力。
加分项：
• 有表情库/皱纹贴图（WrinklesMap）制作经验；
• 有团队带教或外派管理经验（项目急需正职带教）；
• Ziva肌肉解算、面部动捕数据处理经验。 1、负责项目中的角色蒙皮相关工作，包含基础脸型和身体模型蒙皮。
2、在绑定制作过程中，与动画师、建模师、材质渲染师及技术开发人员紧密合作，按照项目的制作时间表完成绑定工作，并达到质量要求；
3、根据流程需要提供优化绑定的方案；
4、定期参与绑定技术的研发，与技术开发人员合作，共同研发新的绑定技巧及技术；

title: 特效TA（无限大）
jd_text:
1、3 年以上的游戏行业特效美术或 TA/TD 的从业经验。参与过主要平台的 3A 级作品者优先。
2、能够熟练使用引擎内的工具制作特效，例如Unity 和 Unreal 中的相关工具。
3、熟练使用 Maya等工具中的模拟和程序化制作技术，并曾经将这些技术在游戏特效中进行应用。
4、能够使用美术工具中的脚本语言进行工具开发。例如 Python，HScript，VEX 或 MEL。
5、能够使用 HLSL，GLSL 或Cg 等高级 Shader 语言进行Shader 编写。
6、能够在引擎中进行编程来实现一些特殊的效果工作机制者优先。

 1、在现有的工作流程内引入新的技术和技巧，以完成更为复杂和精美的效果制作需求。
2、与程序、美术、策划紧密合作，开发使得特效视觉表现和游戏逻辑同步更为紧密的机制 和流程。
3、设计资源管理方面的原则和规定，优化特效代码和美术资源在不同项目之间的共享程度。
4、为特效美术和相关的TA/TD 提供培训，使得他们能够更好的适应新的工具和工作流程。

title: 下沉市场-外卖供给专家
jd_text:
1.想清楚下沉市场该卖什么货。看数据、看趋势、看行业，判断哪些品类、哪些品牌值得重点投入，然后把结论变成各个城市能照着执行的方案。
2.建一套好用的系统，把供给招商往上游推。让商家商品尽量从商家直接过来，将商家怎么谈进来、商品怎么快速上架、活动怎么覆盖、收入怎么管理，这四件事都要在系统里跑顺。
3.让系统越来越聪明（AI建设）。找什么线索、选什么品、定什么价、给什么资源——尽量交给系统去做，人只管最关键的决策。
4.把项目推动起来。定清楚每个阶段做什么、在哪试、什么算成功，然后拉着技术、产品、区域团队一起把它做出来，并对最终效果负责。 1.本科以上，3年以上互联网平台、电商或本地生活相关经验，其中至少 2年做过供给、商品或商家侧的活。
2.从零搭过业务系统或者作业平台，知道一个想法怎么变成产品，也知道产品怎么才能真的被用起来。

title: AI安全防护治理专家 - 安全与风控
jd_text:
团队介绍：我们团队致力于通过对攻防技术的持续研究，最大限度降低零日漏洞与安全事件造成的影响。我们提供红队演练、威胁检测、安全保障工具支持及事件调查等服务，助力提升系统韧性。通过不断强化攻防两端能力，我们在巩固公司核心安全基础、保障数据与业务安全方面发挥着关键作用。

1、AI使用识别与资产梳理：识别企业内部各类AI Agent、Copilot、MCP Server、插件化工具、自研RAG应用和AI自动化工作流，梳理其使用场景、负责人、接入方式、数据访问范围、运行环境和权限边界，建立AI资产清单和风险分级机制；
2、AI Agent行为分析与风险识别：分析AI Agent在Prompt输入、上下文引用、工具调用、API调用、文件访问、网络连接、本地命令执行和身份权限使用中的行为风险，识别敏感数据访问、危险工具调用、越权操作、异常自动化执行和潜在数据外传行为；
3、AI安全检测能力建设：基于端点、网络、身份、云、SaaS、应用日志和AI Runtime日志，建设AI场景检测规则，覆盖未授权AI使用、Prompt Injection、敏感数据泄露、Agent Tool Abuse、MCP异常调用、异常文件/网络访问、本地命令执行等风险；
4、AI安全响应与处置闭环：建立AI安全告警分级、调查和响应流程，支持高风险AI访问阻断、Agent工具调用限制、Agent执行暂停、高风险插件或MCP Server下线、Token/API Key回收，并推动事件复盘和治理改进；
5、AI Runtime可观测能力建设：推动Prompt、Response、Tool Call、Agent Action、MCP调用、身份权限、文件访问、网络访问等关键日志接入安全分析平台，提升AI风险的可发现、可检测、可调查和可审计能力。

title: 智能电动汽车安全体系经理
jd_text:
岗位职责
随着智能网联汽车产业快速发展，新能源汽车安全已从传统被动安全扩展至全生命周期、多域协同的系统性安全治理。本岗位聚焦新能源智能网联汽车5大安全域（电池安全、功能安全、预期功能安全、网络与数据安全、软件/OTA安全）的体系架构建设与落地推进，是公司产品安全体系的核心专家岗位。
1. 安全体系架构规划与建设
•	负责新能源智能网联汽车5大安全域的体系框架规划、制度文件编制与持续迭代
•	构建覆盖"体系治理→全生命周期管理→安全运营→基础支撑"的四层安全架构
•	主导各安全域工作组（电池安全、功能安全、预期功能安全、网络安全、软件/OTA安全等）的机制设计与运行规则制定
2. 体系落地推进与闭环管理
•	推动安全体系要求在研发、制造、供应链、售后等全链路环节的落地执行
•	建立安全体系运行状态的监控机制，定期开展体系内审与管理评审
•	主导外部审核（工信部飞行检查、型式认证、ISO体系审核等）的迎检准备与问题闭环
•	对体系运行中发现的问题进行根因分析，推动举一反三与系统性改进
3. 法规标准追踪与合规保障
•	持续追踪国内外智能网联汽车安全相关法规标准动态（GB 44496、R155、R156、ISO 26262、ISO 21448、GB 18384等）
•	将法规要求转化为企业内部安全标准与流程要求，确保合规零风险
•	参与国家/行业团体标准制定，提升公司在安全领域的行业话语权
4. 跨部门协同与赋能
•	协同研发、制造、供应链、数字安全、法务等部门，推动安全要求融入各业务流程
•	组织开展安全体系培训与赋能，提升全员安全意识与专业能力
•	作为安全委员会核心专家，为重大安全决策提供专业判断与技术支撑

1.资源规划与供给策略：结合MaaS业务发展、模型演进和资源使用情况，预测GPU算力及Token服务需求，制定自建与外采的资源组合、供给规模和交付计划，平衡成本、效率与供应稳定性；
2.采购协同与交付保障：参与GPU算力及Token服务采购，协同采购、技术团队明确资源规格、服务标准和验收要求，评估供应商交付能力，跟进资源到位、服务上线及问题闭环；

title: 海外独立站建站实习生
jd_text:
1. 本科及以上在读，计算机科学与技术、软件工程、信息管理与信息系统、数字媒体技术等相关专业优先。

3. 有 AI 辅助编程经验，能用 AI 生成和修改页面代码，通过实际运行检查结果、定位并修正常见问题。
4. 具备较好的审美能力，对页面布局、配色、字体、图片选择和视觉层级有基本判断。
5. 可在杭州线下每周到岗 5 天，连续实习至少 4 个月。
加分项
• 有可展示的上线站点或页面案例，能说明本人负责的部分。
• 使用过 WordPress、Webflow、Shopify 或同类建站平台。

title: 美团外卖-销售数字化专家(AI方向)
jd_text:
负责外卖某核心品类团队销售任务流管理系统的建设与运营，重构一个大规模销售组织的经营管理范式，围绕OPDCA销售管理流程，用数字化与AI让组织运转与能力复制

1、定义问题与终态：识别销售组织管理中的固有损耗（信息折损、压强衰减、过程失焦），以终为始设计AI时代销售管理操作系统的愿景，并规划“流程数字化→AI辅助流转→AI独立运转”可分阶段抵达的演进路径，
2、主导系统从构想到落地：负责核心管理系统的需求定义与机制设计，将“目标—任务—执行—验收”全流程线上化，覆盖一线销售、各级管理者与后线运营的全角色场景；跨产品、研发、数据团队把控排期与交付质量，推动指标接入、组织架构对接、任务计算逻辑等关键依赖项逐项闭环，保障系统一期按期上线并持续迭代。
3、驱动组织行为迁移：让线上化系统真正替代“线下离线”的经验型管理。以上线采纳率、任务闭环率、信息触达及时率等口径，持续验证组织管理效率的真实改善。利用行政压强、绩效牵引、功能提效等多手段驱动组织作战与管理向新范式牵引
4、构建自运转的经营飞轮：建立任务全生命周期的运营机制，让目标、任务、执行、检核、复盘形成数据闭环，并与绩效体系联动；让优秀经验被自动沉淀与复用，把组织的时间从盯过程解放到做判断。
5、定义AI化的价值边界：在“AI替代人工做功”与“AI增强人的判断”之间做务实取舍，推动目标自动设定、任务自动派发、过程自动监控、迭代自动闭环逐步成为现实；对AI当前能做什么、不能做什么保持手感级的持续校准。 1、基本经验：本科及以上学历，3年以上互联网业务运营、产品运营或销售运营经验；有销售组织数字化（CRM/SFA/任务/绩效系统）或大型管理机制从0到1的操盘经验者优先。
2、销售视角：能熟悉销售组织的运行逻辑，例如目标如何被承接、信息如何被折损、行为如何被激励与约束；能真实理解一线的销售做功流与绩效压力、对系统化管理的抵触点，把管理动作翻译成产品语言
3、推动能力：具备推动大规模销售组织及多协同方改变行为与习惯的实战经验，敢于在逆共识情形下驱动变化，在复杂协同环境中驱动各方共同拿到结果。
4、系统性与结构化思维：能把复杂的组织问题抽象为可运转的模型与流程，表达框架化、结论先行，能同步兼顾以管理层为主、执行层视角为辅的双视角。
5、AI体感与判断：有Agent、工作流、知识库类AI工具的实际操盘经验与提效实践；对AI当前能做什么、不能做什么、业务应该让它做什么，有手感级的判断。

4、基于商家经营流程，洞察机会找到方法，持续验证促有效动销及留存的运营方法论，并推动规模化运营。

title: 越南FMCG华商运营经理-TikTok Shop
jd_text:
1、品牌商家拓展与运营管理：针对中国大快消品类（个护、食品、健康）品牌商家进行业务拓展，引导品牌及代理商入驻越南市场，负责市场调研与商家分析，及时反馈信息并提供建议，制定并落实品类规划；负责中国大快消品类商家的运营工作，构建健康的商家商品生态，扩大商家和商品生态的宽度与深度，高效挖掘优质供给以助力业务增长，并对行业GMV增长负责；
2、商家孵化与运营支持：针对商家进行前期孵化和运营，确保商家的GMV增速符合预期；同时为商家入驻前的准备工作提供相应的数据支持和分析建议；
3、商家支持与市场活动策划：具备一定的商家业务拓展经验，能够针对行业痛点提供商家解决方案的支持，并协调内部资源；具备基础的活动策划能力，了解行业活动动态，定期举办品牌交流峰会等，以实现商家资源的裂变；对内容电商有一定的认知，能够探索并实施提升电商内容效率的有效方法，包括但不限于内容创意构思、内容分发渠道的挖掘与管理、营销活动资源的协调，积极寻求与达人、MCN机构、第三方平台等联盟的合作，以提升产品表现并助力销售增长。

title: 广告客户增长运营-抖音生活服务
jd_text:
1、负责抖音生活服务本地交易或线索方向的广告客户增长运营，深入理解广告投放机制与协同策略，围绕客户增长和营收目标，制定激励、活动、任务、诊断等策略并落地，完成全流程复盘迭代，提升中小广告主规模与质量，对广告收入负责；
2、根据产品与用户阶段制定针对性运营方案，推动模型、内容、营销等产品能力建设，跨部门协同优化全链路转化，提升广告主投放效果；
3、洞察中小广告主经营模式、营销需求与投放痛点，输出清晰的业务规划和可落地的运营方案；
4、围绕广告收入/投广率的业务目标，充分利用AI外呼与AI私域的智能化触达能力以及线上触达渠道，实现策略覆盖率的有效提升与正向效果的持续扩大。

title: 交换机软件研发工程师
jd_text:
1.负责交换机软件的设计、开发、测试和维护工作；
2.根据网络产品及运营需求定义技术规格，并推动需求交付；
3.编写技术文档，包括设计文档、用户手册和维护指南；
4.跟踪业界趋势，推动关键网络技术落地部署及持续演进。

title: 微信小店-后台开发-治理方向
jd_text:
1.负责微信电商治理功能及系统的研发，保障微信电商体系下的用户安全购物体验及公平合规的商家达人经营环境；
2.持续提升优化架构，提升性能、可用性、扩展性及研发效能等；
3.与产品团队协同，解决具体业务场景的问题。

title: 腾讯游戏-高级游戏分析师 -游戏研究与应用
jd_text:
1.跟进国内外相关研发团队，对其团队背景、核心能力、当前管线产品等进行深度竞争力调查，为团队决策提供专业分析报告；
2.对不同阶段在研/运营中的项目需求进行专项跟进，从研发视角分析问题并协助项目团队解决困境，输出专业优化方案与可执行建议；
3.根据品类布局策略，对内外部产品进行系统性评估，辅助产品内容布局与决策；
4.保持对行业生态的持续关注，主动拓展信息网络，跟踪国内外优秀团队与产品动态；
5.参与团队专项研究课题，从产品力、团队力、市场潜力等维度提供结构化分析意见。

title: 《暗区突围》端游-资深游戏运营(宣发方向)
jd_text:
1.负责《暗区突围：无限》的宣发运营工作，深入洞察行业动态、产品特性和用户习惯与特征，结合市场竞争态势，提炼版本核心卖点和舆论热点，制定整合宣发方案和执行策略；
2.统筹并把控宣发物料、内容创意与执行落地，对内容产出、传播效果和用户口碑负责；
3.具备全周期运营视角，能够针对项目不同阶段，尤其是稳定运营期，制定针对性的宣发节奏；
4.统筹协调宣发在版本研发中的需求，促进端内端外相互助力和融合，使产品内容和用户内容更具传播潜力，提升宣发效果；
5.与市场营销、渠道、外部合作伙伴密切沟通合作，整合内外部资源，提升产品认知和热度。

title: 预研项目制作人-RPG游戏
jd_text:
1、负责RPG项目的核心创意与玩法方向预研，核心玩法框架和数值体系的设计与落地规划；
2、统筹程序、美术、策划、运营等职能团队协作，保障版本按时高质量交付；
3、基于用户行为数据、市场反馈和竞品动态，适时调整产品策略以及敏捷开发、验证与迭代。

title: 《逆战：未来》资深系统策划
jd_text:
1.负责游戏内PVP玩法相关系统的设计落地，包括匹配、排位、结算等功能；
2.与关卡、战斗同学配合，提升玩法乐趣性和目标达成；
3.与AI模块保持密切交流合作，确保匹配体验达到预期效果；
4.跟进并分析游戏统计数据，根据数据和玩家反馈制定后续优化方案，并跟进具体开发进度。

title: 《三角洲行动》高级海外系统策划（活动向）
jd_text:
1.负责海外版本游戏活跃系统的设计，包括但不限于活动系统、局外任务系统等；
2.能从用户全生命周期出发，根据用户生命周期所在的不同阶段，针对性地设计和落地相应的活跃调控方案；
3.系统设计过程中，关注功能、规则、表格设计、交互体验和视觉、听觉反馈；
4.跟进、分析统计数据，根据数据和反馈来制定后续优化方案并跟进具体开发；
5.配合策划团队进行游戏活跃内容的创新设计，提出适合海外的新系统设计方案。

title: 公共事务（华南属地）
jd_text:
1、本科及以上学历， 5年及以上的公共事务工作经验； 
2、具有较强的政治敏感度，熟悉游戏、音乐、教育、电商等领域，有公共事务相关从业经验； 
3、熟悉公共事务办事流程，具备资源整合和业务推进能力，能快速开展公共事务相关工作； 
4、具有较强的人际交往与关系建设能力，以及良好的团队合作精神； 
5、具备政策分析和各类公文的撰写能力。 1、根据公司业务在属地的发展需求，建立与地方政府主管部门和行业机构的常态化沟通机制； 
2、研究相关政策法规，了解研判行业信息，分析对业务的影响，为公司发展提供服务支持； 
3、参加公司与公共事务相关的日常沟通，包括日常接待、会议参与、活动支持等。

title: 引擎中台开发工程师
jd_text:
1、本科学历，3年以上经验
2、熟悉 Unreal Engine 引擎工作流，了解资源管理、关卡、蓝图、材质、动画、打包构建等常见模块。
3、具备 UE 项目性能分析经验，能够使用常见 profiling 工具定位问题，并推动修复落地。
4、熟悉美术资源规范和制作流程，能够搭建或维护资源检查、导入校验、自动化处理工具。
5、熟悉 UE 资产烘焙、Cook、Package、Build 等流程，能够排查构建失败及发布相关问题。
6、具备良好的问题分析、沟通和协作能力，能够对接程序、美术、策划、TA 等多个角色。
7、具备跨引擎协作和快速学习能力，能够在需要时支持非 UE 项目的技术需求。
8、具有AI SDD 和 MCP 使用经验。
9、有 unity 相关项目经验更佳。
10、深入精通上述个别技术方向，或者熟悉大部分内容，有过实际项目经验者优先。 1、面向游戏项目组提供 UE 引擎技术支持，解决研发过程中涉及引擎、资源、性能、构建等方面的问题。
2、与项目组共同规划并搭建研发流程与工具链，包括资源规范、导入检查、自动化校验、资产烘焙、打包及批量处理等。
3、参与 UE 项目性能分析、问题定位与优化修复，覆盖渲染、内存、加载、资源占用等方向。
4、根据项目需求，支持 UE 引擎或组件的定制扩展开发。
5、在需要时，支持非 UE 项目的引擎相关技术问题，配合跨项目协作

title: 法律顾问(投资并购/上市合规)
jd_text:
1. 国内外知名院校法律专业本科以上学历，法律基本功扎实，通过国家司法考试，英文可以作为工作语言；
2. 有3年左右知名律师事务所或大型公司法务相关工作经验，具有良好的法律思维及文字表达能力；
3.  具有较强的沟通和团队协作能力以及项目执行能力；
4.  对互联网行业有兴趣且有较强学习能力，诚信正直，做事严谨、细致，有责任心，有较强的抗压能力。 1. 境内外投资/并购项目的法律尽职调查，协调公司外部律师的工作，积极跟进项目进程；
2. 协助项目交易结构的设计、分析、讨论及执行，积极就各个环节涉及的相关法律问题进行法律研究，识别并提示相关法律风险；
3. 协助起草、审阅、修改投资意向书、投资协议、收购协议、股东协议、公司章程等各类投资并购项目法律文件；
4. 协助投资项目的投后管理及风险防控；
5. 上市公司合规（美国上市公司优先）、公司治理、信息披露等事宜。

title: 专家/资深场景概念（归唐）
jd_text:
- 擅长叙事类角色设计，以及写实题材者优先；
- 拥有至少一款高画质手游，PC或主机游戏的场景原画/模型/编辑经验。
- 对场景概念设计原则，形状构图，色彩光影，氛围情绪，人文和自然环境有全面的理解，尤其对中国风建筑景观设计有深刻理解。
- 了解游戏引擎和场景制作流程，对构图，灯光和材质有敏锐的直觉，能协助3D迭代场景表现，跟进游戏内的资产品质。
- 熟练的绘图技巧和软件应用，有至少一款3D软件（例如blender）的辅助设计能力。 - 配合策划，美术负责人制定游戏场景风格，负责游戏中地图、建筑，道具等原画设计；输出原画设计模版和规范；
- 根据游戏的世界观、策划白盒和玩法要求，设计环境概念，包括气氛图，key arts和资产设计。
- 基于叙事需求，输出符合世界观、游戏动机的分镜，把控情绪和氛围；
- 良好的沟通和协做能力，能够将多方需求整合并落实到设计中。

title: 下沉市场-站外流量运营
jd_text:
1、建设线下流量能力：通过本地商户物料铺设、骑手视觉宣传、线下广告覆盖及异业资源合作等手段，提升下沉市场品牌心智，支撑下沉业务DAU提升。
2、统筹本地广告资源：统筹本地广告商，盘点一手广告资源，优化采买模式，推动资源成本下降，提升投放性价比。3、运营机制与SOP沉淀：规划月度运营节奏，沉淀可复用的标准化SOP，搭建常态化站外推广运营机制。
4、AI工具应用与全流程提效：落地AI工具应用（自动化复盘、智能内容生成），提升全流程运营效率，实现物料铺设、广告覆盖等动作的线上化追踪。 1、3年以上本地生活/下沉市场线下推广或广告采买经验。
2、数据敏感，能通过数据拆解与复盘持续发现问题、优化运营动。
3、具备优秀的沟通表达、项目推进、执行落地及跨团队协作能力。
4、对AI工具有实操经验，能主动探索AI在运营场景中的落地应用。

title: 歪马-业务培训专家
jd_text:
1. 培训策略规划：围绕业务全周期需求，结合业务策略制定各阶段合作商及各岗位的分层培养方案，确保培训投入与业务节奏同频。
2. 训练体系搭建：搭建运营训练体系，深入一线提炼业务骨干的隐性经验，转化为可复制的标准课程、SOP、SOC执行检查清单和带教工具包，实现能力沉淀与规模化输出。建立训练员认证机制，保障带训队伍稳定。
3. 岗位训练设计：针对前置仓/鲜酒铺核心岗位，独立完成从岗位标准准入→课程开发转化→训练标准下达→落地执行→效果评估的闭环，做到训有标准、考有依据。
4. 效果评估与追踪：通过门店业绩数据、实操考核等方式追踪培训转化成效，并对差距进行复盘分析反哺方案迭代。
5. AI+培训创新：探索AI在培训场景的应用，包括智能陪练、AI辅助课程开发、数字化学习等方向，提升培训效率与学习体验。 1. 本科及以上，6年以上培训经验，有完整操盘培训项目的经历，连锁加盟/零售业务培训经验优先。
2. 能独立完成核心岗位培训全链路（能力建模→课程开发→交付），具备体系搭建及标准化输出能力。
3. 能建立培训效果评估机制，用数据追踪转化成效并反哺迭代。
4. 关注AI+培训场景，有智能陪练、数字化学习等方向探索经验优先。
5. 优秀的沟通表达与跨部门协作能力，能适应出差，支持全国区域培训落地。

2、具备一定的数据分析能力，熟练使用SQL获取业务指标口径

5、base成都，需与北京团队密切协作

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    An overview of this role 
 As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models. 
 Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources. 
 This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context. 
 Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together. 
 Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence. 
 Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering. 
 Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities. 
 Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures. 
 Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience. 
 
 What you'll bring 
 
 Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information. 
 Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows. 
 A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer. 
 Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.

title: 数据计算平台调度工程师​​（北京/深圳/上海/杭州）
jd_text:
1.负责大数据云原生计算平台的资源管理与调度架构设计，基于 Kubernetes 支持 Spark/Flink/Ray 等分布式计算引擎，提升大规模集群的资源利用率、任务吞吐和运行稳定性；
2.面向批处理、交互式计算及分布式数据处理等场景，设计和优化多租户资源配额、公平共享、优先级与抢占、任务组调度、弹性伸缩等机制，保障关键任务的时效性与资源使用效率；
3.深入优化计算引擎与 Kubernetes 的协同机制，围绕任务启动、资源申请与回收、数据本地性、网络及存储访问等环节，解决大规模作业的性能与稳定性问题；
4.建设高可用、可扩展的调度与任务编排能力，开展 Kubernetes 调度器扩展、Controller、Operator 及 CRD 开发，完善故障恢复、可观测性和容量治理体系；
5.面向 Spark/Ray 等引擎的 GPU 计算需求，与 GPU 资源平台团队协同，建设应用侧异构资源申请、任务编排及 CPU/GPU 协同调度能力，支持大数据计算向异构计算场景演进。

title: Director, Analytics Engineering
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As Director, Analytics Engineering, you'll lead a team of 8 and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You set direction across the data organization, stay close enough to the work to guide technical decisions credibly, and partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, IT, and business leaders. You will have three mandates: 
 
  Build trusted, AI-ready self-service.  Deliver a semantic model that answers business questions correctly, with the telemetry, evals, and model flexibility to prove it and keep costs in check. 
  Set the strategy for how GitLab accesses data.  Own the data models, BI tools, and AI access patterns (Claude, MCP servers, Slack agents) that put trusted data in everyone's hands. 
  Build data applications the whole company relies on.  Ship production-grade apps that combine trusted data, APIs, and AI to answer questions dashboards can't. 
 
  What you'll do  
 
 Build and own a trusted semantic model, with governed metrics and business definitions, that answers business questions consistently across every tool 
 Build evals and ground-truth datasets that measure answer quality, and use them to drive improvements and catch regressions 
 Instrument telemetry to see who uses the semantic model and AI tools, what they ask, and where they get stuck 
 Build a model-selection harness so GitLab can route work across LLMs and stay flexible on cost and quality 
 Own data modeling and curated datasets for self-service, with the ownership, data contracts, testing, and documentation that make them AI-ready 
 Define the AI data access strategy: when to use BI, Claude, MCP servers, or Slack agents, with the governance and security to keep access trusted and reliable 
 Own the enterprise BI and self-service tools strategy (e.g., Tableau, Omni), including evaluation, adoption, and cost 
 Build self-service capabilities, such as Claude skills, documentation, and guided workflows, that help people find and use data on their own 
 Build and own company-wide data applications, from Claude-built single-page apps to apps inside BI tools, that combine Snowflake data, API calls, AI-powered deep dives, and write-back to Postgres or Snowflake 
 Set engineering standards for data apps (security, authentication, testing, deployment, and monitoring) so they're reliable at company scale 
 Set a long-range roadmap tied to company strategy, and a lightweight operating model that balances urgent stakeholder needs with investment in reusable data products and tech-debt reduction 
 Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of 8: build career paths, develop leader

2、热爱游戏，对二游玩家关注的内容和社区话题有了解。
3、熟悉欧美主流内容平台，喜欢关注游戏内容趋势，具备良好的内容判断力和传播嗅觉。
4、有内容策划、社媒运营、文案或视频创作经验者优先。
5、沟通顺畅、执行力强，能够按节点推进多项内容需求。 1、协助策划欧美区域的游戏内容传播，结合版本更新、角色及玩法亮点，提出适合 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram 等平台的内容选题。
2、跟踪欧美游戏及社区热点，收集玩家讨论、热门话题和优秀案例，整理可执行的内容创意。
3、协助撰写英文内容简报、视频脚本及社媒文案，并与设计、视频等团队沟通素材需求和修改意见。
4、整理内容发布计划与表现数据，复盘传播效果，持续优化选题和表达方式。

title: 市场运营实习生（炉石传说-自媒体内容运营）
jd_text:
1. 本科及以上在读，一周可到岗 4-5 天，实习至少 3 个月；能稳定实习 6 个月、覆盖完整版本周期者优先。
2. 熟悉微博、小红书、抖音、B站、公众号的内容形态与发布规则，网感好，能判断内容是否“对味”、是否符合官方调性。
3. 会基础制图与剪辑（PS、剪映等），能按模板完成简单延展；有基本审美，交付素材观感干净、符合官方账号调性。
4. 有条理、有责任心：习惯用表格/清单管理多条线进度、不漏项，主动同步卡点；交付前自查，遇到问题当天反馈；性格沉稳，能沉下心做细致、重复性的推进工作，沟通务实不浮夸。
5. 具备基本内容合规意识：不发布未经确认的内容；涉及敏感信息、未公开版本、合作方信息时先确认再发；遵守官方账号内容规范。
6. 深度游玩《炉石传说》者优先。

加分项： 官方账号或社区账号运营经验 / 拍摄剪辑作品 / 熟悉公众号排版（秀米等） / 能用 AI 工具提效 / 有个人内容账号

你能获得
1. 官方账号实操经验：微博、B站、抖音等多平台发布与运营规则；
2. 完整版本周期的项目经历，以及与多方协作的推进经验；
3. 可写进作品集的真实产出；
4. 与社区主播、创作者接触的机会。

投递要求： 简历 + 作品集，作品集请标注每份作品中你独立完成的部分。 1. 推进与发布：你负责盯住每个版本的内容排期，跟进图文/视频进度，确保内容按时上线；按确认版本完成多平台发布，发布前按清单自检，确认内容符合平台规则与官方调性，并安排执行发布；维护排期表，定期同步整体进度。
2. 内容支持：在既有模板和选题下完成短文案、单图延展、素材调整等制作，按需提供选题参考；也会参与拍摄现场，跟着脚本和物料跟进拍摄。
3. 社区与素材：巡检评论区与私信、及时上报异常，整理归档素材，关键节点主动补位。你也有机会接触社区主播和创作者。在完成排期工作的前提下，你有较大的自由创作空间，鼓励你创作自己想做的内容以及甚至进行小型社区活动的举办。

title: 新作者引入BD - 抖音电商
jd_text:
团队介绍：抖音电商以“总能发现好东西”为主张，致力于成为用户发现丰富好物的首选平台。众多抖音创作者通过短视频、直播、商城等丰富的形式，给用户提供更个性化、更生动、更高效的消费体验。同时，抖音电商积极引入优质合作伙伴，为商家变现提供多元的选择。

3、评测标准落地与持续优化：严格执行平台评测规范，在实操中及时发现标准不清晰或不完善的场景，记录典型案例，帮助进行评测标准和评测流程的迭代优化；
4、经验沉淀与知识输出：根据实际工作中的场景，梳理各类型低质网文的识别技巧和创作共性，帮助模型提升辅助识别低质内容的能力，完成低质网文识别模型的搭建、迭代升级和实际应用。

title: 和平精英-资深3D角色设计师（商业化）
jd_text:
1.根据原画制作高中低模贴图，确保模型的大型、结构及材质符合项目品质要求；
2.负责资源导入引擎后的材质球调试及贴图绘制工作，并在游戏里验收最终效果；
3.跟进外包制作反馈沟通，输出有效明确的修改意见；
4.进行版本缺陷验收修改及给出有效解决方案。

jd_text:

title: 数据中心经理
jd_text:

2.结合IDC实际情况均衡考虑服务质量、效率、成本及安全，以支撑部门的业务运营；
3.负责与运营商的后台团队建立密切、高效合作关系；
4.推动运营商建立面向用户的运营体系，推动运营商IDC建设和运营水平不断提升；
5.负责IDC的基础设施整体可靠性、现场运营质量、运营成本及运营安全，并持续优化及改进；
6.负责IDC现场运维外包团队管理及考核。

title: 《王者荣耀》高级客户端开发（gameplay方向）
jd_text:
1.负责《王者荣耀》MOBA 核心战斗底层逻辑的架构设计、版本迭代与长期维护，保障对局核心逻辑稳定可靠，持续优化全局对局体验与玩家手感；
2.基于项目现有技术架构，独立承担英雄技能体系、皮肤专属表现、场景关卡机制；创新对局拓展玩法的核心研发、调试落地与版本交付；
3.持续优化战斗 Gameplay 研发管线，搭建自动化校验工具与标准化研发规范，提升策划内容生产、功能验证、迭代上线全链路效率，支撑业务高速迭代；
4.负责对局品质与稳定性治理，针对线上崩溃、逻辑异常、对局卡顿等疑难问题开展专项定位、根因分析与闭环复盘；针对全品类移动设备，完成帧率、内存、CPU 耗时等维度的系统性性能优化；
5.联动策划、美术、测试跨职能团队完成需求评审与技术方案共建对齐，输出规范可落地的技术文档，保障版本高质量平稳迭代上线。

jd_text:

2、负责Camera评测团队管理，包括团队能力搭建、人员成长和产出结果；
3、负责影像评价能力建设，搭建和完善图像质量评测体系，提升评测自动化能力；

title: Camera评测资深专家

4、与产品团队合作支撑硬件选型与论证工作。

title: 舆情公关-中国公共关系
jd_text:
1、完成日常性、突发性舆情汇报工作，实时监控、跟踪舆情、出具有参考价值的舆情分析报告等；
2、熟悉本地生活相关业务，能够迅速学习、不断完善舆情判断方法、判断标准；
3、对行业及相关国家政策有一定了解，对事情有自己的观察，有较为准确的判断；
4、有一定资源可获取专家意见并不断改进、更新舆情工作。

title: 天美-UE5微恐射击新品-市场营销经理
jd_text:
1.负责天美J3工作室UE5微恐射击新品多端市场营销工作，包括营销策略、节点推广和内容营销等，负责制定上线期各节点营销推广方案，统筹线上线下执行；
2.整合内外部资源，统筹和执行包括营销事件、创意素材、内容营销、KOL合作、BD合作、线下活动和公关传播等各个工作模块的整合营销活动，并对项目进度和最终效果负责。

title: 3D动作策略游戏《虚环》-资深2D分镜师
jd_text:
1.对接游戏主美、导演、策划团队， 能够自主产出高质量过场PV分镜，大招分镜，以及其他视效动态分镜；
2.审核供应商提交的游戏三维动画宣传片创意与分镜表，确保创意与游戏风格相匹配；对供应商提交的视频内容进行质量控制和反馈，提升作品整体质量；
3.对接编剧和导演审核工作的标准和要求，确保情节与游戏主题紧密相连；
4.确保所审核的作品符合市场需求和观众期望，提高观众满意度；从专业角度出发，提出优化和改进建议，提升品质。

title: 《三角洲行动》-客户端开发工程师（性能优化）-大世界场景
jd_text:
1.参与大世界场景相关构建与运行时的框架维护与升级；
2.参与大世界场景优化技术的设计与实现；
3.负责大世界场景AI自动化分析流程的设计与实现；
4.:负责配合策划，美术同学维护大世界的稳定使用。

title: 次世代3D环境灯光师
jd_text:
1.负责 UE5 大世界地图的整体灯光设计与氛围搭建，含昼夜循环、天气、室内外光照与区域视觉分层。
2.制定灯光规范与参数基线，确定烘焙与实时光照配比、光照贴图精度，平衡品质与性能。
3.结合 FPS 玩法做功能性灯光设计，强化掩体、通道与目标物辨识度，保障竞技公平性。
4.与场景、关卡、特效、TA 协作，完成枪火、爆炸、载具、安全区等灯光联动表现的落地。
5.负责灯光性能分析与优化（PC 与移动端），统一项目色彩基调，推动灯光流程工具化。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深引擎渲染工程师
jd_text:
1.设计并开发资产管线，优化资源处理流程，与技术美术协作制定资产规范标准；
2.持续提升画面品质，跟进业界技术发展，预研前沿方案，争取在项目落地并产生实际价值；
3.开发高质量渲染特性，包括地形、水体、体积渲染等视觉模块，编写高性能Shader；
4.负责渲染性能优化，解决DrawCall、显存占用、带宽、功耗等瓶颈问题；
5.针对项目中的疑难杂症相关问题进行修复，解决兼容性问题。

title: 企业微信-数据库研发工程师-（北京/成都）
jd_text:
1.负责企业微信核心业务板块后端分布式数据库架构设计和工程落地；
2.负责数据库核心模块(如底层存储引擎、复杂公式、查询优化器/执行器等)持续迭代和优化；
3.对现有业务架构进行分析和优化，保障系统的高性能、可靠性以及可扩展性。

title: 《三角洲行动》-客户端开发工程师-工具开发
jd_text:

3.优化资源加载流程，减少等待时间，提升开发体验；
4.与团队成员紧密合作，解决技术难题，推动项目进展。

title: 微信小店-生态治理运营-商家商品治理方向
jd_text:

title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer. 
 Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant. 
 Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry. 
 Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations. 
 Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI. 
 Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback. 
 Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. 
 Join Tier 2  on-call rotations  to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency. 
 Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic. 
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. 
 
  What you'll bring  
 
 Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models. 
 Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses. 
 Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.

jd_text:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer who loves helping customers and can't leave a problem alone until it's solved.

You're an engineer who happens to do support. You pick up new things fast and you're comfortable with a problem nobody has seen before. That matters more to us than your previous job title, and people on our team came to support from various backgrounds.

jd_text:
1. 负责骑手物资的采购、入库、出库及库存管理，确保物资供应及时准确。  
2. 制定并优化物资管理流程，提升物资使用效率与成本控制能力。  
3. 与供应商对接，维护良好的合作关系，保障物资质量与交付时效。

3. 熟悉仓储管理系统及办公软件，具备较强的数据分析能力。  
4. 具备良好的沟通协调能力与责任心，能独立推进工作。  
5. 工作地点为北京市，能适应一定强度的现场管理工作。

 Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it. 
 When another GitLab team launches a credit-consuming capability, you'll help them make it billable across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated. This is a technical, systems-oriented product role: success means building a monetization platform other teams can launch on quickly and correctly, rather than shipping customer-facing UI. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab's usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced revenue. 
 Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time. 
 Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch day. Stay ahead of their roadmaps so billing doesn't delay launches. 
 Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement. 
 Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer's invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable. 
 Support the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team by framing problems, explaining the value of platform investments, and prioritizing them against operational risk. 
 Define and track measures of billing accuracy, pipeline reliability, cost to serve per capability, and time to monetize so teams can make informed pricing decisions.

 Experience owning the product direction of consumption- or usage-based billing systems. 
 Experience with Zuora or a comparable billing and revenue platform, and an understanding of how product and finance systems interact. 
 Experience with prepaid, commitment, or credit-drawdown pricing models (balances, reservations, overage, expiration) and the edge cases they create in billing and revenue.

ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - No going away and asking an expert by default. You will be the expert!

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service. 
 You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow. 
 Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes. 
 Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests. 
 Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient. 
 Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use. 
 Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor. 
 Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely. 
 Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.

 Professional experience shipping productio

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An Overview of the Role  
 As the Customer Advocacy Lead for APJ, you will celebrate our customers and spotlight their achievements, turning GitLab's most successful customers into visible, influential champions. You will identify and activate advocates and their stories that showcase customer outcomes, support pipeline and revenue goals, and deepen trust in GitLab across Asia Pacific and Japan. 
 Reporting into the growth marketing organization, you will own the day-to-day development and delivery of customer advocacy initiatives in close partnership with APJ sales, marketing, and global teams. You will build trusted customer relationships, identify stories and advocates, and connect the right customers to references, campaigns, events, and executive engagements. Because APJ spans diverse markets, cultures, and time zones, you will tailor engagement to local context while creating programs that scale and align with global priorities. 
 In your first year, you will establish clear, measurable advocacy goals for the region, strengthen collaboration with regional stakeholders, and increase the visibility of customer outcomes across go-to-market motions. This is an opportunity to bring the voice of APJ customers forward and demonstrate GitLab’s impact on their business. 
  Some Examples of Our Projects  
 
 Partnering with sales, pre-sales, and marketing to turn complex customer solutions into compelling narratives for campaigns, events, and executive engagements 
 Creating and executing customer references, case studies, speaking opportunities, and other advocacy activities and programs across APJ markets 
 
  What You’ll Do  
 
 Own the APJ customer story, reference and proof library, and associated pipeline. 
 Build and nurture relationships with customer advocates, including senior stakeholders, and identify opportunities for references, case studies, events, and thought leadership. 
 Manage the customer advocacy lifecycle: identify and recruit advocates, understand their goals, coordinate participation, and maintain mutually valuable relationships over time.

title: 高级/资深叙事策划（归唐）
jd_text:
1. 热爱游戏，有丰富的游戏经历，在3A剧情向单机游戏有丰富体验者优先。 
2. 对游戏叙事表达有敏锐的洞察力、感悟力。 
3. 对世界观架构、剧情故事创作和角色塑造有自我深度分析与思考。 
4. 具备对游戏美术、视听语言、角色塑造、环境叙事的理解能力。 
5. 广泛深度的积累量，包括但不限于电影、小说、动漫等各种体裁。 
6. 具备良好的沟通表达能力。 
7. 有编剧经验，台词功底优秀，完整故事或剧本写作经历者优先，请随附个人作品。 1.细化和丰富游戏故事、世界观、人物设定。 
2.基于核心叙事设定和剧本，与关卡/玩法/美术/动画等部门密切沟通和合作，设计并协助实现关卡内的叙事内容，把控in-game叙事体验。 
3.落实游戏剧情的影视化呈现，完成游戏剧本写作。 
4.与程序、技术策划合作，协助和完善叙事落地的相关工具。

title: Principal Engineer, Monetization Engineering
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     About the role  
 We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help define and drive the next generation of GitLab’s Fulfillment platform. 
 Fulfillment ensures that customers receive the right product access and can manage seats, usage, and spend across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, and other deployment models. Its core areas include entitlements, licensing and provisioning, seat management, usage visibility, and cost management. 
 The existing platform has served GitLab for approximately a decade and now faces significant challenges in scale, maintainability, and architectural complexity. This role will help us understand where we are today and define how Fulfillment should work over the next ten years. 
 This is a senior player-coach role. You will set architectural direction across the Fulfillment portfolio, make critical technical decisions, and work directly with teams to execute the resulting modernization strategy. You will influence across organizational boundaries while remaining hands-on in design, implementation, technical problem-solving, and mentorship. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Define and communicate the long-term architecture and technical strategy for Fulfillment, including target state, principles, priorities, and migration sequencing.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  At GitLab, People technology never stands still, and as a People Systems Engineer, you’ll build what keeps it moving. Reporting to the Senior Director, People Technology, and working alongside our Lead People Systems Engineer, you’ll design, build and maintain the automations, integrations and AI-powered workflows that connect Workday, Greenhouse, Slack and the tools that power our global workforce. You’ll own features from request through tested code, deployment and ongoing reliability across Workato, Google Cloud and Claude. With an AI-forward mindset, you’ll rethink how People work gets done, eliminating manual effort and creating streamlined, delightful experiences for team members. If you think like a software engineer, love solving puzzles and want to grow your career at the intersection of people systems, AI and automation in an all-remote, async-first environment, this is your role.

 Build, test and maintain People system automations and integrations across Workato, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Workday, Greenhouse and GitLab, owning your features from design through deployment. 
 Develop integrations between Workday, Greenhouse, Slack and internal tools using Workday Web Services (WWS) and Slack’s API and Bot SDK, and build Slack apps and bots that turn manual steps into simple, automated workflows for team members around the world. 
 Write clean, readable automation code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language, stored and versioned in GitLab, with clear documentation and peer code reviews. 
 Keep pace with a high-growth company by monitoring integration health, troubleshooting failures quickly and fixing root causes so our automations stay reliable at scale. 
 Ship changes safely through GitLab CI/CD pipelines, following testing, change-management and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT general controls (ITGC) standards with care. 
 Lead with AI: use AI tools, large language models (LLMs) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, including Claude, every day to accelerate development, prototype AI agents and reimagine how People work gets done, then share what you learn so the whole team moves faster. 
 Look past the surface of a request to find the real problem, then recommend and build solutions that are durable, scalable and easy to support. Partner with People Technology Analysts on configuration, testing and releases, and with Information Security, IT and AI Engineering on security and standards.

 As Director, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), you'll lead finance for GitLab's Research & Development (R&D) organization, our largest operating expense area. You'll be the strategic finance partner to our Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and their leadership team, owning R&D planning, forecasting, and investment decisions. 
 R&D builds our AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform, which more than 100,000 organizations use. You'll connect investment in headcount, infrastructure, AI and cloud usage, and tooling to product outcomes, with clear measurement and reliable forecasts. 
 You'll sit at the CTO's staff table, shape GitLab's long-range plan, and help leadership decide where to invest next, making R&D spend predictable. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Serve as the finance advisor to the CTO and R&D leadership. Hold partners accountable for execution against plan and connect R&D priorities to company financial targets. 
 Lead annual planning, and rolling forecasts for R&D. Own the operating plan across headcount, compensation, contractors, hosting and cloud, AI and large language model (LLM) costs, software, and tooling. 
 Build frameworks that connect R&D investment to product roadmap outcomes. Evaluate business cases for new initiatives, AI capabilities, build-versus-buy decisions, and vendor commitments, and present risks and opportunities to leadership. 
 Define and track R&D efficiency metrics, including R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost per engineer, hosting cost per user, and AI inference cost per feature. Identify large-scale savings and reallocation opportunities and see them through to completion. 
 Partner with People and R&D leaders on hiring plans, location strategy, and organizational design. Keep headcount forecasts accurate and reconciled to actuals. 
 Lead the AI transformation of R&D finance. Rethink planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows, and use AI tools to make them faster, more accurate, and more insightful. 
 Redesign FP&A processes, policies, and planning and reporting systems for efficiency and effectiveness, with AI in the center. Work with Accounting on capitalized software, accruals, and allocations, and with Procurement on process improvements. 
 Lead and develop your R&D finance team:: hire and coach team members, set goals and priorities, and give expert feedback. Put GitLab's values into practice through handbook-first, asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

title: 松鼠便利物流组华中大区南昌城市群仓配经理
jd_text:
1.上下游协同：定期沟通城市采销、店铺运营，推动双方问题的解决，提升供应商、物流商、门店的满意度。
2.目标管理：根据物流经营目标，制定城市群内策略拆解和重点工作推进，加强过程管理，保障仓配运营效率及成本达标，不断提高供应商送货体验、门店有货率和履约体验。搜集3PL经营分析数据，监控盈亏平衡，为3PL做经营赋能。
3.现场及物流商管理：针对常温FDC、冷链FDC、常温RDC的现场生产问题、差异问题、库存问题、配送问题、逆退问题，协同物流商、外包管理人员快速处理解决。组织美团与物流商日会、周会，推动问题解决。
4.产能管理：承接进销存预测，产能目标和固定工需求、车辆需求管理，持续提升产能和弹性，满足销售需要。 1.专科学历，5年以上年仓储配送工作经验，较丰富项目管理及现场管理经验。
2.熟悉零售供应链业务操作标准、现场优化方法、行业发展方向等。
3.能够快速洞察和诊断业务、组织、人员问题和需求，具备较强的执行力和较强的跨部门协调沟通能力。
4.工作态度积极、细心、稳重、原则性强，有较强的服务意识、沟通能力、协调能力。

3、熟悉骨骼动画、动画混合、IK/FK、动画重定向、Root Motion、动画压缩等技术。
4、熟悉 Unreal Engine 或 Unity 动画系统，有 Animation Blueprint、Control Rig、Motion Matching 或 Mecanim 等实践经验优先。

6、具备良好的沟通协作与问题推进能力。

加分项
1、有动作、ARPG、开放世界、射击或高角色密度项目经验。

3、有自研引擎动画系统或角色控制系统主导经验。 1、负责自研引擎角色动画系统的设计与开发，包括状态机、Blend Tree、IK、动画分层及运行时调试等。

 As a Cloud Platform Engineer on the Runway team, you'll help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and developer tooling that powers our engineering organization. You'll advance our Kubernetes-based platform, mature our GitOps practices, and expand infrastructure as code adoption across the business. This hands-on role brings together infrastructure, automation, and developer experience, helping application teams deploy and operate their services. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Operate and improve production Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments, managing upgrades, scaling, and reliability throughout the cluster lifecycle. 
 Own and extend Argo CD-based GitOps workflows, maintaining ApplicationSets, managing sync policies, and enforcing deployment standards across environments. 
 Write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, with clear practices for state management and drift detection. 
 Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and improve availability, performance, and observability. 
 Collaborate with application teams to onboard services, and create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity. 
 Implement role-based access control, network policies, and secrets management to meet infrastructure security and compliance requirements. 
 Integrate platform capabilities with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support end-to-end delivery workflows. 
  Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.  
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Experience operating Kubernetes in production and working with at least one major cloud provider: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure. 
 Experience with Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling, such as Flux. 
 Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning, including remote state, workspaces, and module design. 
 Ability to write scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go. 
 Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management. 
 Understanding of networking fundamentals, including the Domain Name System (DNS), load balancing, ingress, and service mesh concepts. 
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document systems and collaborate across teams. 
 Optional: experience with managed, multi-cluster, or multi-region Kubernetes, service meshes, policy as code, observability, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure as code; open source or platform tooling contributions; or relevant certifications.

title: Senior Release Engineer
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An Overview of this role  
 We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls. 
 The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification. 
 Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability. 
 Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation. 
 Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as  Salesforce, Zuora,  and other  Business Systems.  
 Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing. 
 Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases. 
 Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards. 
 Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting. 
 Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions. 
 Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.

jd_text:

3.根据需求与上下游环节协作，推进创意设计并落实到游戏环境内；
4.需要对接外包把控设计风格与进度，及时跟进反馈并梳理制作流程。

title: 开放世界-UE特效设计师(上海)
jd_text:

  An overview of this role  
 As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles.  Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process. 
 Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team. 
 Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters. 
 Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab. 
 Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members. 
 
  What You’ll Bring   
 
 Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment. 
 Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required. 
 Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools. 
 Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives

You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities. 
 We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction.  Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure. 
 This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams. 
 We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working. 
   Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada only. Candidates based in the United Kingdom can apply to this posting:   Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — UK (Intermediate to Senior Staff)   
  How our SRE hiring works  
 Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team. 
 
  Recruiter Screen:  A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction. 
  Core Technical:  The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review. 
  Hiring Manager Interview:  A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab. 
  Peer Technical:  Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on. 
  Skip-Level Interview:  A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams. 
 
 After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

   Engineering Manager, Production Engineering - Observability   
   
  An overview of this role  You'll lead the globally distributed Observability team. The team builds and operates the metrics, logging, alerting, and capacity planning platforms that GitLab engineers use to understand  GitLab.com  and GitLab Dedicated. You'll help determine how the team collects, stores, queries, and acts on telemetry, balancing reliable signals with scale and cost. In your first year, you'll guide improvements to Prometheus-based metrics pipelines, log ingestion and retention, alerting driven by service-level objectives (SLOs), and capacity forecasting.  Lead, hire, onboard, and develop a distributed engineering team working asynchronously.

 Own the reliability, scalability, and cost of the team's metrics, logging, alerting, and capacity planning platforms. 
 Reduce noisy or missing alerts and telemetry gaps, and use SLOs, error budgets, and self-service instrumentation to help engineers maintain the health of their services. 
 Guide technical decisions about time-series storage, high-cardinality metrics, log pipelines, and distributed tracing. 
 Participate in the Incident Manager On Call (IMOC) rotation, coordinating the response to high-severity incidents affecting  GitLab.com . 
 Keep the team's on-call rotation sustainable through coverage across time zones, useful runbooks, better alerts, and follow-through on post-incident actions. 
 Use AI tools and agents to support engineering workflows and incident triage, reviewing their output while engineers retain responsibility for decisions. 
  Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.  
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Experience leading an observability, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering team operating at scale, including supporting people in a distributed, asynchronous environment.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    An overview of this role 
 As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. 
 We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest. 
 Our projects include: 
 
   OAuth across Cells:   Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells 
   Global identities:   One user identity that works across organizations and cells 
   Token consolidation:   Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith 
   Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads:   OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes 
 
 What you'll do 
 
 Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services. 
 Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags. 
 Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. 
 Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers. 
 Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes. 
 Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents. 
 Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.

title: AI高级视觉设计师
jd_text:
1、拥有5年以上视觉设计经验，有互联网产品、营销活动设计经验，拥有大型成功案例可作为加分项。
2、具备扎实的视觉设计能力，熟悉版式、色彩、构图及视觉表达。
3、有大促活动或产品功能上新设计经验，能独立完成创意及多渠道物料延展。
4、AI 使用能力强，熟悉 AI 图像、视频或动画工具，并能应用于实际项目。
5、熟练使用 AE，能独立完成常见动效制作、合成及视频输出。
6、沟通协作能力和抗压能力强，能适应多项目并行及紧凑排期。 1、负责运营大促及营销活动的视觉设计工作，包括主 KV、长图、活动图等。
2、负责有道词典、Hi Echo 等新品及功能上新的宣传素材设计。
3、根据不同渠道和推广场景，完成线上运营及产品宣传物料的设计与延展。
4、制作新功能视频素材，涵盖创意构思、AI 动画、素材处理及视频输出。
5、使用 AE 完成产品功能演示、活动宣传等动效设计。
6、与产品、运营、市场等团队协作，推进设计落地，并按时交付。

3、有较强的数据分析能力，熟练掌握计算机操作，业务思路清晰，有计划性及快速执行力；
4、诚信可靠，工作态度积极，具有良好的人际沟通能力及协调能力；

3.熟练运用 UE 引擎，独立自主搭建动画蓝图、精准设置状态机等基础逻辑架构，无缝衔接动画与游戏核心系统；
4.针对已完成的动画测试并精细调优，广泛收集反馈，稳步提升动画品质层级。

title: 微信视频号-短视频客户端开发工程师
jd_text:
团队介绍：我们负责微信视频号客户端(iOS和 Android)的短视频业务开发，负责提供视频号浏览体验，发表，视频图片编辑器，个人主页，广告等多个基础模块。期待对技术保持好奇，对用户体验有追求的小伙伴们加入，和我们一同追求卓越与创新，让书写的代码运行在海量用户的设备上，给用户带来更大的价值。

1. 负责微信视频号短视频客户端日常需求开发，主要负责iOS与Android平台业务开发；
2. 负责微信视频号客户端编辑器，发布器相关需求，开发和维护视频图片编辑，编解码等功能；
3. 分析和优化现有逻辑的可优化点，不断打磨提升用户体验；
4. 开发和维护现有框架及日常需求，提升稳定性与可用性；
5. 研究业界跨平台方向的技术及应用，解决技术研发过程中的关键问题与技术难点。

title: 分拣运营岗(团队负责人)
jd_text:
1. 统筹中转场分拣团队现场运营，负责20人左右团队的排班分工与指挥调度，保障分拣作业高效完成；
2. 建立并完善三方人员协同机制，明确职责与作业标准，做好任务分配、进度跟踪与质量把控，协调解决现场问题；
3. 主导分拣相关项目的立项与落地推进，从规划、资源协调到执行全程把控，推动作业流程或管理方式优化；
4. 关注团队人员状态与梯队建设，结合本地用工特点维持团队稳定性，保障业务持续运转。 1. 具备中转场分拣团队统筹经验，能负责20人左右团队的排班分工与现场指挥，优化流程保障高效运转；
2. 拥有三方协同管理能力，能明确外包及劳务团队职责与标准，做好任务跟踪、质量把控与问题协调；
3. 主导过分拣或仓储改进项目，从立项到落地全程跟进，推动作业流程或管理方式优化；
4. 熟悉本地用工情况，具备团队日常管理与梯队建设经验，能关注员工状态、维持团队稳定；
5. 在排班分工与三方任务分配中坚持标准透明、一视同仁，兼顾多方合理诉求以维持协作秩序；
6. 符合京东价值观：客户为先、创新、拼搏、担当、感恩、诚信。

title: 游戏影视动画师（演出）
jd_text:
1.熟练掌握 3Dmax，Maya，MotionBuilder, 等主流三维动画制作软件
2.熟练掌握动画原理，理解运动规律，注重镜头的艺术性和技术性的统一
3.对视听语言有一定认识，具备一定镜头语言知识，并对相机运动，连镜，故事节奏有充分理解
4.具备较强的沟通能力和应变能力，抗压力强，有团队合作精神
5.热爱动画，电影并有其相关工作经验
6.心态积极乐观，善于沟通，有良好的团队协作及沟通能力
7.会AE或者PR等视频编辑软件的简单操作
8.有影视动画工作经验者优先 1.根据分镜或剧本描述进行3D动画内的角色及场景动画设计及制作
2.配合导演及动画指导，根据镜头需要对角色及场景动画进行调整
3.动捕数据修复，表情动作库等动捕数据相关工作
4.了解导演意图并指导外派团队完成动画制作，同时对其工作质量进行把控

title: 游戏交互设计实习生（逆水寒手游）
jd_text:
1.人机交互设计、工业设计、信息艺术设计等设计类相关专业优先
2.熟练掌握常用的绘图软件（PS/AI/Axure/Figma/Sketch等）
3.强逻辑思维，善于沟通表达，协调合作
4.每周可实习5天，需实习3个月以上
5.热爱游戏，希望投身游戏行业；
6.有unity使用经验、掌握多语言、或有海外留学经验为加分项 1.与网易游戏雷火各专业团队配合，进行游戏的交互设计，负责需求的原型图和流程图设计
2.协助其他交互设计师工作，如游戏的开发与迭代，落地跟进等
3.自主发掘交互体验问题，并主动优化解决
4.语言本地化相关的游戏内开发优化

title: 游戏影视编导（雾海之下）
jd_text:
1. 具备扎实的手绘与造型能力，以及良好的画面构图能力和审美水平。
2. 理解拍摄距离与视场角（FOV）对画面的影响，能够准确表现不同镜头条件下的角色比例、透视关系与空间效果。
3. 熟悉视听语言，能够通过分镜准确表达镜头调度、角色表演、叙事节奏与情绪氛围。
4. 能够准确理解反馈意见，快速、高效地完成分镜修改与迭代。
5. 具备良好的沟通能力，能够深入理解制作人及导演的创作意图，将画面诉求转化为清晰、可执行的分镜方案。
6. 具备主动推进工作的能力与质量意识，能够协调上下游制作环节，推动问题解决与最终效果达成。 职位描述
1. 参与前期内容创意讨论，在剧情大纲基础上丰富和细化叙事情节、角色表演及画面设计。
2. 根据导演意图与脚本文案，为游戏内外动画绘制分镜并制作动态分镜，清晰呈现镜头设计与叙事节奏。
3. 负责游戏商业化内容（PV、宣传短片、买量广告、角色CG、活动剧情动画等）的创意策划、分镜设计与镜头执导，把控叙事节奏、镜头语言、角色表演及氛围，提升成片的吸引力与转化效果。
4. 把控中后期制作质量，跟进Layout、动画、特效、灯光、音乐音效等环节的效果审核与验收，推动最终成片及引擎内效果落地；主动协调制作问题，灵活推进方案执行。

title: 资深/专家角色原画（归唐）
jd_text:
1. 擅长叙事类角色设计，以及写实题材者优先；
2. 优秀的角色性格把控能力和丰富的人文知识储备。
3. 多年成型项目游戏制作经验
4. 善于表达和分享技术成果，能够启发和引领团队人员对角色的导向性理解和运用。 1. 参与游戏前期世界观构建，负责设计游戏项目角色风格，制定风格标准。
2. 负责概念设计以及设计任务的分析分解。
3. 根据角色原画设计流程，参与对角色原画设计稿件的评审。
4. 参与制作部门对角色原画设计稿件的分析。
5. 跟进角色跨部门协调，协助角色和动作、过场动画、文案的沟通和落地以及效果把控；
